Distance = 12 × 10 = 120 nautical miles = 120 × 1.852 ≈ 222.24 km (≈ 222,240 m); the speed in other units is 12 kn ≈ 22.224 km/h ≈ 6.17 m/s. To reach a port 300 nautical miles away within 24 hours, the required speed = 300 ÷ 24 ≈ 12.5 knots.
